Name: Harvest_Feast_Invitation
$Comment: The invitation line: one line this file adds to every other character's conversation while Harvest
Feast runs, so a player carrying the invitation tour (the host's quest harvest_feast_invitations) can
ask anybody along. It reaches characters that have a conversation of their own; the game's own
merchants and townsfolk have none, so they never show it. Three villagers stand in the Forgotten
Temple while the feast runs (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Miller_Temple.json, _Weaver_Temple and
_Shepherd_Temple), each with a conversation of their own, so there is always somebody to ask.
Dialogues.Exclude keeps the line out of the seasons' hosts' conversations: nobody invites the cook to
The QuestState condition shows the line only while the tour is carried. Once with Period Daily and
PerConversation true is spent with the character asked and nobody else, so one walk can ask several
people, and the same character can be asked again from midnight UTC. MarkTalked with no Target
credits whoever the player is talking to, and its Qualifier is what the tour's step counts, so no
other talk step on the server moves the tour. Close ends the conversation, since a line added to
another character's conversation has no screen of its own to go to. The line pays nothing itself:
the tour pays once, when it is handed in. Season hides the line whenever the feast is off; to take
it out everywhere, set Enabled false in a file of the same name.
